resources.string: Only during a prayer focus session that you started, this service checks which app came to the front. If it is on your blocked-apps list, it returns you to the home screen. It does not read screen content, passwords or messages, and sends no data anywhere.
Tap to open the app. You can end the session at any time.

Namoz Vaqti uses Android's Accessibility Service ONLY to detect which app is opened while a prayer focus session is running, so it can block the apps on YOUR blacklist.

• It does not read your screen, texts, passwords or messages.
• It collects and shares no data.
• It is active only during prayer sessions you enabled.
• You can turn it off at any time in Settings → Accessibility.

Many phones (Xiaomi, Samsung, Oppo, Huawei and others) stop apps in the background to save battery. Without these settings, the adhan may not sound and prayer focus may stop working.
Allow the app to run in the background without battery limits.

Needed so the adhan sounds exactly on time.
Step 4 – Lock the app in Recents
Open the Recents screen, then lock or pin Namoz Vaqti (long-press the card or tap the lock icon, depending on your phone). Locked apps are not closed by “Clear all”.
On Android 13+, apps installed from an APK file may have “Restricted settings”. Open App info, tap ⋮ (top right) and choose “Allow restricted settings”, then enable the service again.
Could not open that screen on this phone. Opened App info instead – please follow the manual steps below.

1. Settings → Apps → Manage apps → Namoz Vaqti → Autostart: ON.
2. Same page → Battery saver → “No restrictions”.
3. Settings → Battery → turn off any battery saver mode.
4. Lock the app in Recents (step 4).

1. Settings → Apps → Namoz Vaqti → Battery → “Unrestricted”.\n2. Settings → Battery → Background usage limits → turn off “Put unused apps to sleep”; make sure Namoz Vaqti is NOT in “Sleeping apps” or “Deep sleeping apps”, and add it to “Never sleeping apps”.\n3. Lock the app in Recents (step 4).

1. Settings → Apps → App management → Namoz Vaqti → Battery usage → “Allow background activity” and “Allow auto-launch”.
2. Settings → Battery → for Namoz Vaqti turn off “Optimize battery use” (“Don't optimize”).
3. Privacy / Permissions → Startup manager (Auto-launch) → enable Namoz Vaqti.
4. Lock the app in Recents (step 4).

1. Settings → Battery → App launch → Namoz Vaqti → switch to “Manage manually”.
2. Enable ALL three: “Auto-launch”, “Secondary launch” and “Run in background”.
3. Settings → Battery → turn off Power saving mode.
4. Lock the app in Recents (step 4).

1. Settings → Battery → Background power consumption management → Namoz Vaqti → “Allow high background power consumption”.\n2. i Manager / Settings → Apps → Autostart → enable Namoz Vaqti.\n3. Lock the app in Recents (step 4).

1. Settings → Apps → Namoz Vaqti → Battery → “Unrestricted” (or “Don\'t optimize”).\n2. If your phone has an Autostart or Background activity setting, enable it for Namoz Vaqti.\n3. Lock the app in Recents (step 4).
